picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award tasks Brookhaven National Lab and Stony Brook with building a national AI foundation model for the electric grid — a flagship federal bet on AI infrastructure for energy reliability.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant to Notre Dame's AIM for Scale will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of smallholder farmers, pairing major philanthropic AI funding with tangible global impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection to help negotiate a DOE award for the 'Mine of the Future' initiative signals a serious federal-academic-industry push to modernize critical mineral extraction with AI.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston chemists combined AlphaFold AI screening with quantum atomic-magnetometer sensing to target antibiotic-resistant superbugs, a genuinely novel cross-disciplinary approach to a growing public health threat.
picks.title: University of Houston Awarded $1.26M NIH Grant to Outsmart Superbugs | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: UAB's foundation-model work fusing electronic medical records with RNA sequencing to predict cancer treatment response could meaningfully improve precision oncology decision-making.
picks.title: How one researcher is working toward AI use for cancer patient treatment

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's award-winning AI 'digital human' avatar for early dementia detection demonstrates a clinically deployable tool with real diagnostic impact, recognized by an outside design award.
picks.title: AI-powered early dementia-detection tool earns Texas A&M a Fast Company Innovation by Design Award – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: King's College London researchers found that AI models trained on 'dark genome' viral remnants can improve chemotherapy response prediction, opening a new genomic signal source for personalized cancer care.
picks.title: Ancient viral remnants in our genome may help predict response to chemotherapy | King's College London

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's laser-based 'biodynamic imaging' system uses AI and the Doppler effect to personalize chemotherapy selection by directly observing how tumors respond, a distinctive physics-meets-AI diagnostic approach.
picks.title: Lasers, Doppler effect personalize chemotherapy drug selection for cancer tumors

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn's DeepGI AI system for colonoscopy-based colorectal cancer screening won a national public-sector excellence award, underscoring real clinical adoption of AI diagnostic tools in Southeast Asia.
picks.title: Chula Medical Innovation Receives Excellence Award 2026 - Chulalongkorn University

picks.editorial_note: Aalto University's fully automated robotic platform for discovering energy-storage materials shows how AI-driven lab automation can accelerate materials science critical to the clean-energy transition.
picks.title: Robot accelerates the search for energy-storage materials | Aalto University
